limits: Track IDs are local to one review and are not employee identities.
Events are pixel-region candidates, not distance or regulatory conclusions.
Tracking cannot recover detector misses or guarantee ID continuity under severe occlusion.
Open-vocabulary detection was evaluated in research only and is not in the main demo.

streamlit_apptest.method: Source deployed app via Streamlit AppTest + real CPU detector/video; initial render then detection click
